pages.title: Barrier Devices
pages.text: Raise a great examination barrier without the spell. Use the device to form a barrier centred on you; use it again to release it. Each tier costs more mana and covers more ground.

$(l)Tier 1:$() radius 32 blocks, 150 mana$(br)$(l)Tier 2:$() radius 48 blocks, 250 mana$(br)$(l)Tier 3:$() radius 64 blocks, 350 mana$(br)$(l)Tier 4:$() radius 96 blocks, 450 mana$(br)$(l)Tier 5:$() radius 128 blocks, 550 mana
pages.title: Tiers

pages.text: Radii are for the default grandBarrierRadius of 128. World height and border limits still apply.
